49:1.text: O you who believe! Make not

49:2.text: O you who believe! Raise not your voices above the voice of the Prophet
, nor speak aloud to him in talk as you speak aloud to one another, lest your deeds should be rendered fruitless while you perceive not.

49:3.text: Verily, those who lower their voices in the presence of Allâh’s Messenger
, they are the ones whose hearts Allâh has tested for piety. For them is forgiveness and a great reward.

49:4.text: Verily those who call you from behind the dwellings, most of them have no sense.
